newsitem.title: BELGIUM: HAMALAINEN SEES STABILITY PACT DEAL THIS YEAR.
newsitem.headline: HAMALAINEN SEES STABILITY PACT DEAL THIS YEAR.

text.p: Finnish Central Bank governor Sirkka Hamalainen said on Saturday she believed the European Union would reach agreement this year on a stability pact for countries joining monetary union.
Hamalainen said she did not see any severe obstacles on the issue, which was discussed during the meeting of EU finance ministers and central bank governors in Dublin this weekend.

They made much progress on key aspects of the stability pact, which is intended to ensure budget discipline also after the introduction of economic and monetary union, even though several important details remain to be solved.
"Certainly they will reach agreement this year," Hamalainen told Reuters after the meeting on Saturday.
She said Finland did not oppose fines for countries running excessive deficits but noted that the size of those fines was still an open issue.
The question of possile Finnish ERM entry had not been discussed during the meeting but Hamalainen refused all further comment on the issue.
